messages:
isabel: Quick thread for Ledger customer LoRA bring-up. Ran a focused 30-invoice quickpack + 80-case stress set. Artifacts: base(redwood/xl-7b fp16), ledger-lora-alpha fp16 merge, ledger quant variants int8 and int4. Short summary first: int8 tolerable, int4 shows decimal truncation, hyphen-splits on order IDs, and occasional currency-symbol loss.
tom: thanks. high level metrics?
isabel: pasted aggregated table below (quickpack + stress). fmt = formatting diffs vs expected canonical, halluc = numeric hallucination flags.

```
model                         EM   F1   halluc   fmt_mismatch   mean_embed_delta
redwood/xl-7b_fp16 (base)     88%  93%  1.2%     2/280          0.000
ledger-lora-alpha_fp16        89%  94%  1.0%     1/280          0.001
ledger-lora-alpha_int8        88%  93%  1.6%     4/280          0.004
ledger-lora-alpha_int4        82%  88%  7.3%    21/280          0.029
```

isabel: examples: expected "$9,250.00" -> int4 outputs "9250 dollars" or "9250.0". Order id "ORD-123-XYZ" -> tokenized as "ORD - 123 - XYZ" breaking downstream regexes.
harry: tokenization/embedding check?
isabel: ran token L2 diffs. High deltas concentrated on `$`, `,`, `.`, and the `-` token used in order ids. Mean delta for these tokens ~0.031 on int4. KV-cache streaming diffs observed for a handful of traces in kernel logs.
priya: pipeline used? merge-before-quant or apply-on-quant?
isabel: we did merge -> tiny-clip -> blockwise quantize (group_size=128, calib=1024). Commands: 
```
commit: g5h6i7
merge: tools/merge_lora --base redwood/xl-7b --lora ledger-lora-alpha --out /tmp/ledger-merged
clip: python tools/clip_small_weights.py /tmp/ledger-merged --thresh 1e-5
quant: tools/quantize --model /tmp/ledger-merged --bits 4 --group 128 --calib 1024 --method blockwise
```

tom: same pattern we've seen elsewhere. Two mitigation experiments to try: A) quantize base first then graft the LoRA (graft-on-quant), B) post-quant per-token logit bias for numeric/currency/sep tokens, C) re-run blockwise with smaller group_size (32 or 64) and a numeric-centric calibration corpus.
harry: I want to add D) try GPTQ-style per-channel quant or smoothquant to see if it preserves rare-token geometry. Worth a quick run.
priya: I'll prototype a per-token logit-bias map focusing on these tokens: [`$`, `,`, `.`, `-`, digits 0-9, `ORD:`, `INV:`] and include tokenized currency words. Rough approach: compute embedding delta per token (pre/post quant), map delta -> small logit adjustment during decoding (scale factor tuned on held-out set). Script: `tools/make_token_bias.py --pre fp16 --post quant4 --tokens tokens.txt --out bias.json`.
isabel: for experiment matrix I'll run: 1) graft-on-quant, 2) merge-then-quant with group=64/calib=4096 + numeric-corpus, 3) merge-then-quant + priya bias map, 4) GPTQ per-channel quant baseline. Posting kernels and quickpack outputs here.
qa-bot: queued expanded quickpacks for all variants. Blocking thresholds: halluc > 3.5% OR fmt_mismatch > 10/280. Current int4 baseline (21/280) -> blocks canary.
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for `ledger-lora-alpha_int4`. tag:blocked.
tom: additional thought: try doing a lightweight 1-epoch adapter re-finetune on the quantized base (graft + 1 pass) rather than straight apply; sometimes tiny re-adaptation recovers numeric tokens. Could be quicker than full retrain.
harry: good call. Add variant 5 = graft-on-quant + 1-epoch micro-finetune on numeric prompts.
priya: note that logit bias can overfit; I'll include a 500-sample validation mix to ensure we don't introduce new hallucinations. Will post `bias.json` and before/after diffs (diff format: count of fmt fixes vs introduced regressions). ETA EOD.
isabel: reproduction for local dev: 
```
# reproduce
git checkout g5h6i7
python tools/run_quickpack.py --model /tmp/ledger-merged --prompts evals/ledger-invoices-30.json --out quickruns/1748301234
```

qa-bot: running expanded stress set now. expect artifacts in /evals/ledger/1748301234-report.json.
tom: let's hold canary promotion until we see variant results. tagging @deploy-bot: keep block.
deploy-bot: confirmed. Promotion remains blocked for ledger int4. :no_entry_sign:
isabel: thanks team. reconvene after runs. Will summarize best candidate and kernel traces in the morning. :coffee:
